messages.subject: ezperm ...within vs between
parts:
Hi,

I wrote a previous message, but now have another question. I have 50
subjects each were subject to a treatment and control. In ezPerm, I
was using the the subject id (factor of 1 to 50) as "wid" and
treatment/control as "within". Would it be more appropriate to
consider treatment/control as "between". Thanks, I'm relatively savvy
with regression but am just now learning anova techniques for a
smaller part of my research.

Seth

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] ezperm ...within vs between
parts:
If you measured the same individuals in each condition, that condition
should definitely be treated as "within", else (1) you lose power and
(2) most functions in ez will fail. The latter is because most ez
functions expect that there is no overlap in wid values between groups
defined by a "between" variable and crash if they encounters overlap.
